hooks.command: for p in python3 python py; do "$p" -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info[0] != 3)" 2>/dev/null && exec "$p" -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/notify.py"; done; exit 0
